edges.note: Posted by Kirkpatrick after the 26 July 2023 hearing and authenticated by the Pentagon, calling the hearing insulting to DoD and IC officers. Signatory: Sean M. Kirkpatrick, then AARO director. It contradicts nothing Grusch swore to; it substitutes a procedural complaint for a substantive rebuttal.

b.label: House Oversight hearing, 26 July 2023 - 'Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Implications on National Security, Public Safety, and Government Transparency'

edges.label: Post-hearing statement rebutting the harm claims
edges.note: Gough stated the Department has no information that any individual has been harmed or killed as a result of providing information to AARO, and warned that unsubstantiated harm claims discourage witnesses. Grusch's sworn claim was about harm in the concealment effort, not about providing information to AARO - the denial answers a question that was not asked.

title: DefenseScoop - UAP hearing sparks clash between Pentagon officials, witnesses
